comparison: EPF minus LR; engineered inputs and clean fit in both; EPF linear_anchor versus independently validation-selected LR C
view: clean held-out OOF from the original five PSU test folds
seed_handling: Mean of three EPF seed metrics; seedless LR repeated only to align paired comparisons, not an LR ensemble

survey.method: n_h-1 draws with replacement; multiplicity*n_h/(n_h-1); full survey PSUs; no FPC

uncertainty.scope: Paired full-frame PSU bootstrap of fixed OOF predictions; conditional on fitted models
uncertainty.limitations: Post-hoc comparison after inspecting held-out condition results; no multiplicity correction, full retraining uncertainty, or independent cohort. Do not promote this condition as a test-selected winner.

privacy: Only aggregate statistics; no participant rows, predictions, role indices, or absolute source paths
